name: SANY SSR200C-10S unmanned road roller
summary: A 20 t single-drum soil roller with an optional driverless kit that compacts a closed-off site on its own after one click.

germany.statusNote: Not offered in Germany: SANY Europe's roller range (SSR80, SSR120, STR30, STR40) does not include the SSR200C-10S, and its brochure lists a Euro III engine. The unmanned kit is a separately priced option, requested through SANY's global quote form; first use outside China was in Brazil (January 2026).

specs.label: Unmanned road roller kit
specs.value: driverless operation within an enclosed site with one-click automatic compaction; intelligent compaction system and equipment management platform

specs.label: Kit features
specs.value: Beidou satellite positioning, wireless communication, autonomous driving, digital steering, intelligent compaction, active obstacle avoidance
specs.conditions: labels on the brochure's smart-kit figure

notes: Driverless only inside an enclosed site; otherwise driven from the cab.
Steel vibrating drum in front and driven rear tyres; a padfoot shell is an option for wet clay.
SANY also runs a third-generation unmanned paving and compaction fleet (paver plus rollers) on more than 50 projects in China, but sells no named fleet product.
